name: Raskina
slug: Vecna's red-skinned tome, made from his sister and held by Grixto.
description: Raskina is Vecna's tome, also called the Book of Vecna and his red-skinned book. He made it from his sister Valkyrie: he killed her, skinned her half alive, and used her blood as ink. He cast the runes. The void torn in the family, and demons, wrote the pages, and he gained knowledge from those demons. The cover looks like black leather and is taken to be her skin. It is an extremely powerful spellbook. Grixto has it, and it is the reason he has access to many spells. He found it when he began turning from dragon rider to hunter of dragon riders. Vecna says it has legacy, story, and a need for grandeur, that he still needs the physical book, and that it can seek a phylactery, ease an itch, hold life and death, and bring back lost people, things, or beings. Walker and Vecna agree it is not Grixto's phylactery, though Vecna floats, hypothetically, that it could be identified as one.

log.summary: Grixto has the Raskina. Sylan calls it an extremely powerful spellbook and the reason Grixto has access to many spells. Dana names it the Book of Vecna and says it is what he found when he began turning from dragon rider to hunter of dragon riders. Carlkin reacts as if this is catastrophic. Walker saw its look and the name Raskina in Emhet's vision of a newly changed young lich. An unnamed listener fears the darkness in it and tentatively links it to the fall of their order. Vecna wants his red-skinned book back, calls recovering it a family reunion, and gives Walker a miniature field-notes copy about a foot by a foot, not the tome, plus a separate small bright-red quill with no inkwell. The miniature's pages feel as if they would crinkle, its cover matches the sister-skin book from the vision, and the quill is semi-warm. Writing in the miniature is enough for Vecna to answer. Walker takes both and postpones any deal.
